hook.name: AuthSwaps
hook.description: A KYC-gated Uniswap v4 hook that restricts swaps, liquidity additions, removals, pool initialization, and donations to addresses verified through the Manifest Finance Auth Manager. Enforces an on-chain allowlist of approved Uniswap routers per chain, then checks the actual user's KYC, ban, and sanctions status via the auth manager.
